name: Rosaline Martinez
source: Rosaline is the founding member and face of Squad Zero, an elite assassin squad under the Zero Program, an assassin branch inside of the secret agent organization Adelcorp. Players watch as Rosaline faces a long line of tragic events growing up from a child that eventually shape her into the world's deadliest assassin. As the main protagonist in the series Rosaline narrates her life in every episode, with the exception of season 2 in the series
